title: DeepSeek R1-0528 and ElixpoSearch join the model shelf
summary:
New reasoning and search models arrived alongside domain-auth tooling and a round of account-system cleanup.

The text API picked up DeepSeek R1-0528 for reasoning work and ElixpoSearch for search-oriented tasks. More options through the same endpoint, because model routing is apparently a garden now.

A new domain-management command-line tool makes it easier to configure domains for user authentication without turning the setup process into a browser-tab expedition.

User metrics, refreshed account-tier descriptions, and per-user interaction tracking add more visibility around how accounts and platform surfaces are used.
